name: Haj Pilgrimage to Saudi Arabia
benefit: - Air fare of ₹24,000/- is given as subsidy for each pilgrim. - Free medical facility is provided at Mecca. - Subsidy is distributed towards airfare to each and every pilgrim when he applies through the State Haj Committee. - The pilgrim should comply with the requisites stipulated for eligibility and application procedure.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be an Indian citizen. - The applicant must have sound health. - The applicant must not have performed Haj for the preceding five years.
